description: This PHP class models a tree structure of organizational units (subunits) in an HRM system, transforming a flat list of Subunit entities into a nested hierarchical array with optional child nodes.

classes.name: SubunitTreeModel
classes.description: A model class for representing a hierarchy of organizational subunits, convertible to a nested array structure for serialization or API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an array of Subunit entities.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the hierarchical tree of subunits into an array suitable for serialization.

methods.name: toTree
methods.description: Private recursive method that builds a nested tree array from a flat collection of Subunit objects based on their levels.
